title: marketing
text:
marketing

Lauren: Drafted the product launch post and dropped it in Drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-draft — want quick reads: 3 headline options, benchmark heatmap, webinar CTA + hubspot mappings. feedback pls
Mike: on it. FYI sales will dig into the benchmark claims so keep language conservative.
Lauren: agreed. current claim reads: "up to 40% lower median token latency on our internal 8k-context harness compared with common hosted endpoints" — thinking we should soften.
Sarah: also call it p50 not median? be consistent. and avoid wording that sounds like a named competitor.
AJ: data check — that 40% is p50 across a mixed trace dominated by short calls. on long streaming sessions the improvement narrows. propose: "up to 40% lower p50 token latency on our internal test harness (results vary by workload)."
Mike: that phrasing looks good. Legal should clear comparative phrasing.
Jen (Legal): quick note: no direct competitor references. AJ phrasing is ok if you add a one-line methodology note in the doc and store the raw data in the appendix.
Lauren: will add methodology blurb and attach raw CSV. thanks.
Priya (Growth): UTMs — planning to route blog hero -> webinar reg. What utm params do we want for organic vs paid?
Lauren: proposing: 
```
utm_source=blog
utm_medium=organic
utm_campaign=redwood-launch-q2
utm_content=hero-cta
```
Paid: replace utm_medium=paid and utm_content=paid-hero-cta
Priya (Growth): great. can you also drop a CSV for HubSpot mapping so ops can map first_touch?
Lauren: adding mapping CSV to the doc. sample rows:
```
page_path,utm_campaign,hs_workflow,registration_flow,first_touch
/blog/launch,redwood-launch-q2,workflow_blog_to_webinar,standard,blog
/blog/launch,redwood-launch-q2,workflow_blog_to_webinar,paid,blog
```
Evan (Sales Ops): can the webhook include first_touch=blog as a property so reps can see origin in the lead record?
Lauren: yes — will add to webhook mapping and include the field in the CSV. cc @Evan.
Priya (Growth): webinar scheduling — two candidate slots: Wed Apr 7 10am PT (Americas) and Thu Apr 8 4pm CET (EMEA). Which goes in hero?
Mike: put Wed Apr 7 in the hero. show the EMEA time as an alternate inside the reg modal.
Priya (Growth): ok will create two events in HubSpot and wire UTMs. I will run a test flow tomorrow morning.
Sam (Design): I uploaded two hero options in Figma — product shot and benchmark heatmap. which is primary?
Mike: product shot wins for quick scan; heatmap can sit inline near the benchmark section.
Sam (Design): will update assets and export for web with the right aspect ratios.
Lauren: headline options in the doc: A) "Ship LLM features with predictable performance" B) "Production-ready inference for builders" C) "Inference that scales: fast, reliable, economical" Thoughts?
Priya (Growth): A resonates with devs. B is good for platform teams. pick A for hero.
Sarah: micro-edit: change "cost-conscious" -> "cost-efficient" in the subhead if using option C anywhere.
Lauren: updated: hero = A + subhead "Fast, cost-efficient, and reliable inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
Mike: CTA copy suggestion: "Reserve your seat" instead of generic "Register" — better intent.
Lauren: updated CTAs across hero + modal to "Reserve your seat".
Jen (Legal): final pass: copy + benchmark phrasing OK with attached methodology note. keep raw results in drive as referenced.
Evan (Sales Ops): HubSpot mapping approved. I'll add the first_touch property on the webhook and the workflow.
Priya (Growth): I wired UTMs and created the two registration pages. I'll share screenshots after a test run.
Lauren: last ops ask — can we get final hero asset and CTA text by EOD Friday? growth needs to kick off paid creative next week.
Sam (Design): will deliver PNG/SVG variants by 3pm PT Friday.
Mike: looks good overall. one tiny ask: include a short alt headline for social cards (shorter char count).
Lauren: adding social headline variant and setting publish target Tue Apr 12 10am PT pending final assets. tagging @growth @sales-ops for handoff. Thanks everyone :rocket:
